Haryana Experiences Rain, Waterlogging; Weather Alert Issued

Heavy rainfall in Haryana has caused significant waterlogging, particularly affecting the Dwarka Expressway tunnel. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a yellow alert for 15 districts in the state. The monsoon is expected to weaken until September 10, with increased humidity. A Western Disturbance is predicted to become active on September 11, potentially altering weather patterns again after September 15. Farmers have been advised to irrigate crops following the expected activation of the Western Disturbance.
